pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Garmin GMA 1347 audio panel for the Mission Observer station. Drives the copilot side of X-Plane's audio system: MIC selection, per-source audio monitoring, split COM, marker beacon and the four ICS isolation modes. COM3 is the CAP VHF-FM mission radio and routes to the Mumble mission net rather than to a simulated transceiver.
